title: Bounded execution of remainder reduction
statement: Let the machine limits be given, and let $P$ be a program and $d$ a call depth. For natural numbers $M,V,fr,a$ with $a\le V$, assume $1\le M$, the space limit is at most the word limit, $4V+4M+16$ is at most the word limit, and $fr+\bigl(\operatorname{Nat.log}(2,V+1)+2\bigr)$ is at most the space limit. Let $r$ be the binary size of the quotient of $a$ by $M$, and suppose a memory function $\mu'$ stores $M2^j$ at address $fr+j$ for every $j<r$ and agrees with a memory function $\mu$ at every address below $fr$. From the state whose locals are $[x,M,fr,a,r,t]$ and whose memory is $\mu'$, the remainder-reduction program has an execution of cost at most $24r+4$ ending in the state whose locals are $[x,M,fr,a\bmod M,0,t]$ and whose memory is still $\mu'$.
